name: Manaksia Limited
about: Manaksia Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides galvanized steel coils and sheets, color-coated steel, and pre-painted aluminum coils and sheets in India and internationally. The company operates through Packaging Product, Metal Products, and Others segments. It offers roll-on pilfer-proof closures for sealing solutions for glass and plastic bottles; crown closures for brewing companies and carbonated beverage manufacturers; color-coated aluminium coils and sheets for roofing and cladding applications; and aluminium alloy ingots. The company also provides steel products, including hot dip galvanized steel and pre-painted profiled sheets under the Sumo brand; metal containers, EP liners, washer, and EP sheets; and kraft paper for packaging applications. In addition, it is involved in the trading of spare parts of machine comprising paper machine and consumables. The company was formerly known as Hindusthan Seals Ltd. Manaksia Limited was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
